news_cards.title: NBA ne 33 States/UTs aur National Institutes ko Rs. 3.79 crore ki ABS di
bullets: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) ne 33 State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) aur Union Territory Biodiversity Councils (UTBCs) ko Rs. 3.79 crore ki ABS di.

ABS ka upyog India ke agrobiodiversity ka vishal kshetra hai, jismein tomato, chilli, brinjal, cauliflower, watermelon, bitter gourd, bottle gourd, okra, mustard seed varieties aur deep-frozen Sahiwal cattle semen shaamil hain.
ABS ka upyog karke kisanon ko unke biodiversity ka labh uthane aur unke kisanatmak karyon ko badhane mein madad milegi.
